Red.label: Red style (direct and quick)
Red.guidance: Be brief and direct. Lead with the outcome or result. Avoid unnecessary detail or small talk.
tips: Put the main point or result in the first sentence.
Keep it short and leave out extra details.
If you need something, say clearly what and by when.

Yellow.label: Yellow style (friendly and lively)
Yellow.guidance: Use a warm, enthusiastic tone. Keep the message engaging and personable rather than overly formal.
tips: Start in a friendly way and keep the tone warm.
Share the good side first, if there is one.
Avoid sounding too formal or cold.

Green.label: Green style (calm and caring)
Green.guidance: Use a gentle, reassuring tone. Avoid sounding demanding. Leave room for the recipient to respond in their own time.
tips: Use a calm and kind tone.
Explain the reason behind your news or request.
Avoid sounding pushy. If it is urgent, say so gently and explain why.

Blue.label: Blue style (careful and detailed)
Blue.guidance: Be precise and detailed. Support any claims with specifics. Present information in a logical order.
Blue.closing: Please let me know if you need any more information.
tips: Give clear facts and details in a logical order.
Be exact about numbers, dates and what you need.
Avoid exaggerating or using vague words.
